helpPlay: p <idx>              Play the card at idx
helpPickUp: u                    Pick the trick up (you cannot follow)
rule: Winning a trick scores nothing; the winner is whoever runs out of cards first. Fail to follow suit and the whole trick goes into your hand -- the penalty is being given cards, not taking them. Everyone starts with eight, and the deck is sized to the table (32 for four players, 40 for five, 48 for six).
promptPickUp: You cannot follow. Use pickup to take the {{n}} cards on the table.
gameEndYou: Game over! You ran out first.
gameEndStalemate: Game over! Nobody ran out, so it goes to {{name}}, holding the fewest at {{n}}.
hintPickUp: [HINT: you have to pick it up ({{reason}})]
hintReasonLead: Lead your longest suit -- short suits are what get you stuck
hintReasonFollow: Taking the trick gains nothing, so play low
